findings.title: ENG-TOOL assessment omits implemented legacy PlateMold use cases
findings.detail: The recommendation rationale says only ProductProcess plate-number scalars are visible. Fixed main actually contains Erp/PlateMoldService create/revise/update/delete/search/labels, PlateMold native No40/Rev/Base identity, /api/plate-molds routes, two ERP Vue pages, and Program 588/590 registration. Omitting this accepted compatibility surface mis-scopes migration and leaves cross-Owner order relink/delete plus NoOp PE writers out of the actual code assessment.
